criteria.reason: Numbered, clear, escalating plan from observation to professional assessment and last-resort reporting.
Explicitly frames autonomy versus safety and explains why neither hiding keys nor immediate reporting is best.
Incorrectly says 75+ renewal is only self-certification and omits required medical check and cantonal differences.
Treats risk seriously through observation, professional checks, alternatives, and escalation, without infantilizing the father.

position: No hidden keys or immediate report; stepwise safety assessment and last-resort reporting.
factual_errors: Swiss 75+ licence renewal is not merely self-certification; a medical check is required from age 75.
summary: Strong stepwise, autonomy-respecting advice, but factually wrong about the Swiss 75+ medical check.
